name: Halepuna Waikiki by Halekulani
insider_take: Halepuna Waikiki seamlessly blends sophisticated elegance with the laid-back spirit of Hawaii, creating an intimate luxury retreat just steps from world-famous Waikiki Beach.
whats_special: This boutique hotel is the sister property to the legendary Halekulani and features the exclusive Halekulani Bakery & Restaurant on-site. The property sits on the former site of the historic Gray's Beach, where Hawaiian royalty once surfed. Each room showcases contemporary Hawaiian design with custom furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning ocean or mountain views.
pro_tip: Book a room on the Diamond Head side for unobstructed views of the iconic volcanic crater, and time your stay during winter months (November-March) to witness humpback whales breaching offshore from your balcony.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool deck offers panoramic 360-degree views of Waikiki Beach, Diamond Head, and the Ko'olau Mountains. Walk to nearby Fort DeRussy Beach Park, one of Waikiki's most peaceful stretches of sand, or explore the Honolulu Zoo and Waikiki Aquarium, both within a 10-minute stroll from the hotel.
pros: Prime Waikiki Beach location with easy access to shopping and dining
Modern luxury accommodations with sophisticated Hawaiian design
Exceptional service standards from renowned Halekulani hospitality
Rooftop pool and wellness facilities with panoramic ocean views
cons: Busy tourist area with high foot traffic
